label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
**Reply to send:**

---

Rohan. Straight, no PR. First correction though: 6 of 14. Not half. I know it feels like half — it's my life and I have to look at those 6 people in the eye every day — but the maths, my friend. 🙃

And Ajay, yes, I saw the LinkedIn post. I wrote it at 2am after a day of calls that went nowhere. "Grateful for every team member" is not a lie, I'm grateful, I'm just not grateful for the *phrasing*.

Here's the actual situation:

**What happened.** The bridge round from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 Oct. It wasn't a valuation fight, the term sheet was basically ready — they pulled. The VC partner said "we love the energy" on the call and then stopped replying for 11 days. Eleven days of "we love the energy" doing a lot of heavy lifting.

**What we did.** Cut 6 people last Friday, gave everyone 2 months' pay, and 4 of them already have interviews lined up. Firing people was the worst day of my life, worse than failing maths in 2nd sem, and I include that in the official record.

**Where it stands.** ~41k monthly users. Plumbers and electricians side is genuinely growing. AC servicing is bleeding money on every single job, so we're shutting that vertical down and putting everything into housing society tie-ups — 3 societies in HSR have already signed pilots. Runway is about 5 months after the cuts.

**Your money.** Your 3 lakh is in the same instrument, same terms as everyone else in that friends round. No special treatment, no "founder's friends" ladder. And Rohan — I'm not going to stand here and say "we're crushing it, relax." I can't. Money is at risk. It's not gone, but the risk is real and I won't pretend otherwise, because you trusted me with real money and Divya asked you a fair question over dinner. You were right to ask.

The societies thing — I genuinely think we have a real shot. It's not a sure thing. I'd rather tell you "not sure" and be wrong than tell you "safe" and be lying.

**What I want to do:** call you and Divya properly this week, on a call, and show you the numbers line by line — users, burn, runway, the pilots, all of it. You can decide after that. If you want your money back at the next available window, tell me and I'll work out what that looks like. But I'd rather you hear it from me with the actual spreadsheet than from a silence.

Also: amma asked me last week if TCS is still hiring, so if this thing dies I am going home to a very disappointed woman. And I've been eating Maggi at the office at 11pm so often that the security uncle now asks if I want masala or plain before I even reach the desk.

**But Saturday is happening.** Pranav is buying. I'll be there, I'll be normal, and nobody's allowed to say the word "runway" after the second beer. If the company dies before Sunday, at least the app survives till then. 🫡

Pranav — you're buying, and I want the full spread, not the "one bottle each" fraud you pulled last time.

@Rohan — call you Thursday. 8pm? Bring Divya, she deserves to hear it from the guy who took the money, not from a WhatsApp forward.

reasons: Karthik never actually says he is fine; 'I'll be normal' on Saturday only hints at it, though the rest of the required points (layoffs, funding, runway, plan, risk but not gone, call this week, Saturday, Pranav buying) are covered.
